translations: 编辑选中的自定义话题

entries.source: Double-click a series to wire it.
translations: 双击序列即可将其接入此输入。

entries.source: These object topics share a name but have incompatible types, formats or marker descriptions, so the datasets cannot be merged:
translations: 这些对象话题名称相同，但类型、格式或标记描述不兼容，因此无法合并数据集：

entries.source: Data source '%1' is a file on a local machine, which a web layout cannot open.
translations: 数据源“%1”是本机文件，网络托管的布局无法打开。

entries.source: The layout records its streaming sources more than once.
translations: 布局中的流式数据源列表出现了多次。
用于持续接收数据流的扩展
编辑选中的自定义话题

entries.source: Not subscribed. Drop it into a view to start streaming.
translations: 尚未订阅。拖入视图即可开始接收数据流。

entries.source: Double-click a series to wire it.
translations: 双击序列即可将其接入此输入。

entries.source: "%1" cannot be displayed on its own, but a plugin panel can read it.
translations: “%1”无法单独显示，但插件面板可以读取它。

entries.source: %1 topics cannot be displayed on their own, but a plugin panel can read them.
translations: %1 个话题无法单独显示，但插件面板可以读取它们。

entries.source: Plugin '%1': the saved configuration is not a JSON object and cannot be replayed.
translations: 插件“%1”：已保存的配置不是 JSON 对象，无法重新应用。

entries.source:
Undistort the image using its matching CameraInfo. Turn off to show the raw image,
for example when the stream is already rectified.
translations:
使用匹配的 CameraInfo 对图像进行畸变校正。关闭此选项可显示原始图像，
例如当数据流已经过校正时。

entries.source: Provider '%1' refused the import descriptor for '%2'%3
translations: 提供方“%1”拒绝了“%2”的导入描述符%3

entries.source: %n scene layer(s) could not be rebound and were omitted.
translations: %n 个场景图层无法重新绑定，已跳过。

entries.source: %n source(s) write decoded samples directly and are not recorded: %1
translations: %n 个数据源直接写入解码后的样本，未参与录制：%1

entries.source: '%1' cannot be deleted: '%2' of %3 reads its output
translations: 无法删除“%1”：%3 的“%2”正在读取其输出

entries.source: '%1' cannot be deleted: the protected '%2' reads its output
translations: 无法删除“%1”：受保护的“%2”正在读取其输出

entries.source: '%1' has no owner and cannot be deleted from here
'%1' was created by %2 and cannot be deleted from here
Data source '%1' could not be downloaded: %2
Data source '%1' is not the file its layout was saved with (its content fingerprint differs).
translations: 数据源“%1”不是保存布局时所用的文件（内容指纹不同）。

entries.source: Data source '%1' records a malformed content fingerprint.
translations: 数据源“%1”记录的内容指纹格式错误。

entries.source: Failed to publish the source-promotion service for '%1': %2
translations: 无法为“%1”发布数据源转换服务：%2

entries.source: Layout '%1' records %n streaming source(s); the desktop loader does not start them.
translations: 布局“%1”包含 %n 个流式数据源；桌面加载器不会启动它们。

entries.source: Nothing to record: %n active source(s) write decoded samples directly, which cannot be recorded.
translations: 没有可录制的内容：%n 个活动数据源直接写入解码后的样本，无法录制。

entries.source: Nothing to record: start a streaming source first.
translations: 没有可录制的内容：请先启动一个流式数据源。
请选择“%1”以重新载入此布局（当前选择的是“%2”）。
显示光标处数据点的数值

entries.source: The layout's data sources exceed the %1 MiB a downloaded layout may load.
translations: 布局的数据源总大小超过了下载布局允许加载的上限（%1 MiB）。

entries.source:
These derived topics read what you are deleting. They stay, but report a missing input:

• %1
translations:
以下派生话题读取了将要删除的内容。它们会保留，但会报告缺少输入：

• %1

entries.source: Preset '%1' cannot be opened: this page's preset list is invalid.
translations: 无法打开预设“%1”：此页面的预设列表无效。

entries.source: This page has no preset named '%1'.
translations: 此页面没有名为“%1”的预设。
显示或隐藏外观模型网格

entries.source: Only depth-encoded images can be displayed in a 3D view. Use a 2D view for colour images.
translations: 三维视图只能显示深度编码图像。彩色图像请使用二维视图。

entries.source: This view shows dataset %1; a topic from dataset %2 cannot be added to it.
translations: 此视图显示数据集 %1；无法向其中添加数据集 %2 的话题。
插件“%1”拒绝了已保存的配置：%2

entries.source: Streaming: pause playback to interact with the timeline
translations: 正在接收数据流：暂停回放后可操作时间轴

entries.source: Automatic re-runs a changed marker rule on its own, at the reload rate below. Manual only flags it as needing a refresh, reachable from the dataset's "Refresh derived" action.
translations: 自动模式按下方的重新加载频率自动重新运行已更改的标记规则。手动模式仅将其标记为需要刷新，可通过数据集的“刷新派生标记”操作进行刷新。

entries.source: Every Record press creates one folder here holding one standard MCAP file per recorded source. Recordings capture the raw messages of the topics each stream is subscribed to; sources that write decoded samples directly (no message format) are not recorded.
translations: 每次点击录制都会在此创建一个文件夹，为每个参与录制的数据源保存一个标准 MCAP 文件。录制内容为各数据流已订阅话题的原始消息；直接写入解码后样本的数据源（无消息格式）不会参与录制。

entries.source: Rescale a plot's vertical axis to fit its curves whenever a curve is added or removed (the shared time axis is left unchanged).
translations: 添加或移除曲线时，自动调整图表纵轴以适应曲线范围（共享时间轴保持不变）。

entries.source: Camera calibration topic, used automatically by 2D and 3D views. It cannot be displayed on its own, but a plugin panel can read it.
translations: 相机标定话题，由二维和三维视图自动使用。无法单独显示，但插件面板可以读取。

entries.source: The source configuration uses %1, which is not a deployment variable this PlotJuggler knows.
translations: 数据源配置使用了 %1，但当前版本的 PlotJuggler 无法识别该部署变量。

entries.source: Occupancy updates in this seek window exceed the %1 MiB limit
translations: 此跳转时间窗口内的占据栅格更新超出 %1 MiB 上限

entries.source: A scene pipeline has no HDR variant on this GPU
translations: 此 GPU 上某个场景管线没有 HDR 变体

entries.source: The browser can no longer read '%1': it changed or was removed on disk since it was opened. Data loaded from it may be incomplete; open it again to reload it.
translations: 浏览器无法再读取“%1”：该文件自打开后已在磁盘上更改或移除。从中加载的数据可能不完整，请重新打开以重新加载。

entries.source: An AI agent is controlling PlotJuggler through MCP. Click to see what it is running and stop it; closing this page stops it too.
translations: AI 智能体正在通过 MCP 控制 PlotJuggler。点击可查看并停止其任务；关闭此页面也会停止任务。

entries.source: An AI agent is controlling PlotJuggler through MCP. Click to see what it is running and stop it. Turn this off in Preferences → Appearance.
translations: AI 智能体正在通过 MCP 控制 PlotJuggler。点击可查看并停止其任务。可在“偏好设置 → 外观”中关闭此功能。

entries.source: '%1' has no content fingerprint yet: it is still being computed, or the file changed since it was picked. Save the layout again in a moment, or open the file again.
translations: “%1”尚无内容指纹：仍在计算中，或文件自选取后发生了更改。请稍后再次保存布局，或重新打开文件。

entries.source: Not connecting to the AI agent relay %1: it must be an http address on this computer (127.0.0.1).
translations: 未连接到 AI 智能体中继 %1：它必须是本机（127.0.0.1）上的 http 地址。

entries.source: The MCP server could not listen on 127.0.0.1, so AI agents cannot reach PlotJuggler.
translations: MCP 服务器无法监听 127.0.0.1，因此 AI 智能体无法连接 PlotJuggler。

entries.source: An AI agent asked you to choose:
Let AI agents control PlotJuggler (MCP server):
translations: 允许 AI 智能体控制 PlotJuggler（MCP 服务器）：

entries.source: Open and save files with the system's own file dialog instead of PlotJuggler's (Save Layout keeps PlotJuggler's). It does not stall on disconnected network drives, but does not follow the app's theme.
translations: 使用系统自带的文件对话框打开和保存文件，而不使用 PlotJuggler 的对话框（保存布局仍使用 PlotJuggler 的对话框）。它不会因断开的网络驱动器而卡住，但也不会跟随应用的主题。

entries.source: Serve the Model Context Protocol on this computer only (127.0.0.1, behind a secret token), so AI agents such as Claude Code or Codex can open files, read series, and draw in their own tabs. The status bar names an agent while it is active. Shows whether outside agents may connect now (also when allowed with --mcp); on by default; applies on OK. An agent a toolbox plugin starts itself gets its own private access and does not need this.
translations: 仅在本机提供模型上下文协议服务（127.0.0.1，使用秘密令牌保护），让 Claude Code 或 Codex 等 AI 智能体能够打开文件、读取序列，并在各自的标签页中绘图。智能体活动时，状态栏会显示其名称。此开关显示当前是否允许外部智能体连接（包括通过 --mcp 允许的连接）；默认开启，点击“确定”后生效。工具箱插件自行启动的智能体拥有独立的私有访问权限，无需开启此项。

entries.source: Time zone of the clock times shown while the date-time toggle (bottom left) is on.
translations: 启用左下角的日期时间开关时，时钟时间所使用的时区。

entries.source: Show time as clock time (HH:mm:ss) instead of seconds
translations: 将时间显示为时钟时间（HH:mm:ss），而非秒数

entries.source: Use time offset: show time relative to each dataset's start (axis begins at 0) instead of absolute time
translations: 使用时间偏移：显示相对于各数据集起点的时间（横轴从 0 开始），而非绝对时间
